newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Elka loses ground.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Elka loses ground.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed with cable maker Elka and Zagrebacka Banka losing ground.
* Three of 12 active issues rose, three fell and six were flat.
* Volume slightly higher at 6,858 shares, turnover rose to 2.4 million kuna from 1.9 million kuna.
* Most active food processor Podravka was also the top gainer, inching up one kuna to 291 on volume of 3,714 shares.
* Biggest loser cable maker Elka fell 34 kuna to 111, trading 200 shares.
